in_marathi.name: Ahil
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ahil हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Ahil is a Sanskrit name derived from the Hindu god Ahila, who is believed to be a manifestation of the moon god Chandra. The name Ahil is revered in Hindu mythology for its spiritual significance, symbolizing calmness, wisdom, and protection.
